description: Search products sold by Spanish online shops indexed by SeeStocks (es.seestocks.com) and get their current selling prices. Write `consulta` in Spanish, the way a shopper would (e.g. 'taladro percutor bateria', 'zapatillas running mujer 38'); an EAN barcode or a shop SKU also works. Use `marca` or `tienda` only when the user names a brand or a shop; a brand written inside the query is detected automatically. Results are sorted by relevance (best match first); to find the cheapest products of a type, use explorar_categoria instead, or pass `precio_max`. If the user has already chosen one specific product (brand + model or EAN), use comparar_precios instead. Prices are in euros as sold by the shop; `envio_eur` is the shipping cost (null means unknown, not free). Only relevant matches are returned: `total_relevantes` counts the matches among the best ~200 candidates, it is not the size of the catalogue. Each result has an `id`: use it with ficha_producto to get the price in every shop that sells it. `bajada_precio_anterior_eur` is a real price drop recorded by SeeStocks.
